findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pabandi_get_business · Private data: pabandi_discover, pabandi_connect_finance, pabandi_zk_realestate_proof · Public sink: pabandi_get_business, pabandi_predict_booking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pabandi_get_business · Private data: pabandi_discover, pabandi_connect_finance, pabandi_zk_realestate_proof · Public sink: pabandi_get_business, pabandi_predict_booking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
